records.requirement_text: The visit note should clearly state why the patient is being seen.
Assessment should connect symptoms, diagnosis, functional limitation, or clinical problem to the treatment plan.
Document what was performed, such as acupuncture points, technique, retention time, adjunct therapies, and patient response when relevant.
Each proposed diagnosis code should be supported by the clinical note or referenced patient-reported medical record.
Each proposed procedure/service code should be supported by documented services, units, time, modifiers, or payer requirements when applicable.
Document relevant safety review such as pregnancy, anticoagulants, infection, red flags, or referral needs.
